title: Choose the local engine for container publishing
goal: Pin the intended local container engine when SDK defaults could load images into a different engine or image store.

selectionNotes: Actual Windows GA SDK explicit Docker selection, owned linux-x64 image load and network-disabled execution; payload printed both dispatch records and image was removed. Explicit absent Podman failed CONTAINER1012 without Docker fallback. Successful Podman loading/execution and other platforms are not established.
The selected engine must be installed and available; choosing an unavailable engine is an error.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Intended managed consumer target; not an observed runtime result.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: SDK11 supplies explicit LocalRegistry selection; observed available-Docker and absent-Podman controls are separate evidence.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Intended language mode of the original managed consumer; the XML glob configuration itself is language-neutral.

packageAssets: SDK-provided Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers tasks; a compatible, digest-pinned runtime base image index must be supplied.
platforms: A host supported by SDK 11 and the selected engine; example image targets linux-x64 and linux-arm64.
prerequisites: Install and configure the engine you explicitly select; no engine is installed by consulting this guidance.
Select a real compatible base image and keep registry pushes separate from local engine loading.
constraints: An already installed, reachable engine is required; Playbook neither installs nor contacts it.
Wslc and MacOSContainer are property values; wslc and container are executable names.
Target 11 only; .NET 10 sources are previous-release comparisons, not an additional historical foundation or a tested older-target route.
Playbook only serves embedded guidance. No provisioning, registry push, telemetry transmission or consumer mutation is performed by consulting it.
